claim: The equation refines established atmospheric-emissivity parameterizations with a humidity–cloud interaction and fixed site calibration. These terms represent effective radiative conditions, not directly measured cloud fraction. Same-site temporal validation cannot establish unseen-site portability or novel radiative physics.
prior_art: Existing domain parameterizations; see PRIOR_ART.json. No certified novelty.
falsification: All baselines and alternatives evaluated on identical frozen eligible observations; no confirmation promotion.
scope: Only daytime empirical clear/all-sky emissivity diagnostics; no nighttime extension, no independent cloud observations, no cloud causality.
admission_rationale: Supported as a scoped predictive extension; novelty and demonstrated industrial impact are not established.
